Anna: Morning all — quick async check
Anna: What I did: merged fixes to SDK quickstart docs and bumped sampleapp deps (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samples/pull/742)
Anna: Blockers: M1 macOS CI is still failing on the sampleapp e2e (flaky dialog test). Logs look like:
```
E2E: TimeoutError: element not found after 30s
at tests/dialog.test.js:42
```
Anna: Today: triage CI flakes, follow up with infra on macOS runner, open a revert if we can't stabilize.

Sam: Thanks — can you paste the failing job link?

Anna: https://github.com/redwood-inference/actions/runs/1234567890

Priya: I hit the same locally on my Intel devbox once; running `yarn test:e2e --grep 'dialog'` reproduced it.

Kevin: @ci-bot, any recent runner image changes in the past 48h?

ci-bot: Runner image updated 2026-03-05 — node 18.16 -> 18.17, chromium 114 -> 116. See changelog: https://ci.example.com/agents/runner-changelog

Sam: Could be chromium bump. Try pinning chromium in the test container to 114 and rerun.

Priya: I'll try a quick patch in the sampleapp Dockerfile and push a canary to the CI matrix.

Anna: If that fails, I can temporarily skip the flaky test with an issue link to follow up.

Kevin: Also reminder: docs quickstart PR needs a tiny wording change on the auth section — @Anna can you update to mention API keys and env var name REDWOOD_API_KEY?

Anna: Yup, will add that line. Also added a small example snippet:
```
curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY\" \\ 
  -d '{"model":"open-llama-3"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

Priya: Heads-up — I branched for a sampleapp feature (local caching) that depends on kv-cache libs; I'll rebase after the PR merges.

Sam: Nice. If rebase touches test infra, ping me and I'll help with CI matrix.

Anna: Thanks everyone. I'll update thread when CI re-run completes.

Kevin: :thumbsup:

Anna: last: opened issue tracking the flake: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samples/issues/321 — adding tags flaky/ci/m1
